CBSE Class 10, 12 Date Sheet 2027 Expected Soon

The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) is expected to release the tentative exam schedule for Class 10 and 12 board exams for the year 2027 soon, possibly within the current month. Once released, students will be able to access the detailed timetable on the official CBSE website, cbse.gov.in.
